items.title: Our toolchain assumes one human writer, AI agents break that illusion
items.raw_excerpt: Our tools assume one writer, and assume that writer is a human. Nothing computes what a change reads and writes at runtime, so the only known fix is brute force priced for organizations.

title_i18n.en: Our toolchain assumes one human writer, AI agents break that illusion

title_i18n.es: Nuestra cadena de herramientas asume un escritor humano, los agentes de IA rompen esa ilusión.

excerpt_i18n.en: Our tools assume one writer, and assume that writer is a human. Nothing computes what a change reads and writes at runtime, so the only known fix is brute force priced for organizations.
excerpt_i18n.zh: 我们的工具假定只有一个作者，且该作者是人类。没有任何机制能在运行时计算变更读取和写入的内容，因此已知的唯一解决办法是针对组织的暴力破解定价。
excerpt_i18n.es: Nuestras herramientas asumen un solo escritor, y asumen que ese escritor es humano. Nada calcula lo que un cambio lee y escribe en tiempo de ejecución, por lo que la única solución conocida es la fuerza bruta con precio para organizaciones.

excerpt_i18n.en: Recently, Shenzhen Chaowei Dongli Intelligent Technology Co., Ltd. (hereinafter "Chaowei Dongli") and Peking University Medical Management Co., Ltd. (hereinafter "PKU Medical") have reached a deep cooperation. The two parties will jointly innovate around data collection, world models, and simulation training for embodied intelligence in medical scenarios, pragmatically building a complete path from "simulation training" to "scenario verification" and then to "hospital application." For embodied intelligence to truly "enter the hospital," it is never as simple as placing a robot directly in a ward. It must first understand the hospital and medical staff, then follow the rhythm of "simulation—verification—application," step by step accumulating capabilities and completing safety verification. This is precisely what Chaowei Dongli and PKU Medical are working together on—not rushing for quick results, but first solidifying the foundation and paving the way. The biggest bottleneck for embodied intelligence in medical scenarios is the lack of environments for training and teachers for guidance—there is neither highly realistic medical scenarios nor operational data from high-level medical staff. As a full-stack embodied intelligence large-model enterprise, Chaowei Dongli possesses a complete technology foundation from data collection and world models to high-fidelity simulation training. Meanwhile, PKU Medical provides the most authentic clinical scenarios and the most professional medical expertise. The combination of their advantages makes the pragmatic and verifiable path of "simulation training → scenario verification → hospital application" clear and replicable—exactly what is needed for high-safety scenarios like healthcare.

In Shanghai this July, the buzz at WAIC 2026 might be louder than the cicadas. Nearly every booth was packed, with visitors' eyes shifting between exhibition panels and exhibitors' faces. Many came with the same question: Where exactly is China's AI industry now? Leiphone specially planned WAIC 2026 observation coverage, speaking with decision-makers from eight participating AI Infra companies, trying to capture what everyone truly cares about this year through conversations by the booths—and what new directions and consensus are forming in the industry.

01 Setting Sail | From Scaling Up to Competing on Efficiency

This year, an interesting trend emerged: whether from CEOs or business leaders, they all mentioned the same thing—at WAIC 2026, the industry's focus has shifted. Previously, discussions centered on metrics like thousand-card clusters and GPU performance. Now, the conversation has turned to how to stably and cost-effectively produce tokens in bulk, and on that basis, how to use these stable, low-cost tokens to support the continuous and stable operation of agents and AI applications.

Market data clearly reflects this shift. In 2025, the total market token call volume surged 300 times year-over-year. Growth for leading large-model companies is now entirely driven by API and token calls. For example, Zhipu's annualized revenue has broken through from an expected 700 million to 1 billion USD, with the core growth coming entirely from inference-side scale.

Muchos llegan aquí con la misma pregunta: ¿hasta dónde ha llegado realmente la industria de inteligencia artificial de China? Lei Feng ha organizado un informe especial de observación del WAIC 2026, donde hemos conversado con ocho tomadores de decisiones de empresas expositoras de infraestructura de IA, intentando capturar en las conversaciones junto a los stands qué es lo que realmente preocupa este año y qué nuevas direcciones y consensos se están formando en la industria.

excerpt_i18n.es: El marco MEDRGAG, a través del proceso de organización del conocimiento "recuperación-completado-selección", integra la recuperación externa con el conocimiento paramétrico interno, resolviendo la dicotomía de "falta de recuperación y alucinación generativa" en las preguntas médicas.
